Овен.short: a powerful start, leadership, bold decisions
Овен.description: An energetic reset point in Aries gives a strong push for personal beginnings, displays of courage and the launch of new projects. A time to take the initiative into your own hands.

Телец.description: An eclipse in Taurus highlights themes of resources, money, comfort and stability. Long-term financial cycles are set in motion and material values are reassessed.

Близнецы.description: The focus falls on communication, learning, travel and connections. An excellent moment to change how you think, launch a media project or pick up important skills.

Рак.short: new intentions, a focus on home and family
Рак.description: The eclipse brings up themes of ancestry, property, emotional security and the creation of family traditions. A time to lay the foundation for inner comfort.

Лев.short: an impulse toward change, creative energy
Лев.description: It awakens a powerful creative potential and a thirst for self-expression, romance and recognition. A time to declare yourself and your talents to the world.

Дева.short: new work cycles, order and health
Дева.description: A time to reboot routine processes and work systems, care for your body and introduce healthy habits. An excellent start for business processes.

Весы.short: a reset for relationships and partnerships
Весы.description: It activates themes of unions, personal and business contracts, and the search for balance and harmony in dealings with other people.

Скорпион.description: An intense point of rebirth. The eclipse uncovers hidden processes and crisis points, and helps transform old patterns.

Стрелец.description: It sets the direction for study, travel, legal matters and a shift in worldview. A time of large-scale plans and a search for new meaning.

Козерог.short: a career leap, structure and goals
Козерог.description: The focus falls on professional achievement, status, long-term strategy and taking on new responsibility.

Водолей.description: A time of breakthrough ideas, digital projects, joining forces with like-minded people and stepping beyond familiar limits.

Рыбы.short: new intentions, a powerful start to a cycle
Рыбы.description: It opens a deep spiritual cycle. A time of strong inner insight, retuning the subconscious and trusting your intuition.

Овен.description: The peak of tension in the sphere of personal initiative and struggle. A time to finally end drawn-out disputes and release built-up aggression.

Телец.description: A culmination in the material sphere. A time to close out debts, review sources of income and let go of excessive hoarding.

Близнецы.short: clarity in information, contacts come to an end
Близнецы.description: Tangled situations in communication, paperwork or travel become clear. What was hidden comes to light, and unneeded connections are cut away.

Рак.description: A culmination of themes tied to family and place of residence. A time to let go of old grievances from the past and find emotional independence.

Лев.short: a creative outcome, a peak in love
Лев.description: The completion of projects tied to creativity, the stage or children. A time to see the real fruits of your efforts and of recognition.

Дева.description: It draws a line under matters of order, work and health. An ideal moment to bring crystal clarity and clear out the clutter of routine.

Весы.short: a resolution in relationships, partnership outcomes
Весы.description: A culmination in the sphere of unions. Relationships that have run their course come to a final end, while harmonious ones reach a new level.

Скорпион.description: The most powerful emotional peak. A time to free yourself from psychological blocks, heavy memories and toxic attachments.

Стрелец.short: the results of study, a change of beliefs
Стрелец.description: The completion of educational cycles, legal proceedings or far-reaching projects. A review of the old system of values.

Козерог.description: A culmination in your career. A time to take stock of years of work and give up outlived goals and rigid frameworks.

Водолей.description: The outcome of taking part in group projects, a sharp change in your outlook on the future and the severing of outdated friendships or social ties.

Рыбы.description: A culmination of hidden processes, the dissolving of old illusions, a powerful spiritual cleansing and the closing of karmic debts.
